create_period_range: create a fixed-frequency PeriodIndex using start, end, and periods parameters
create_period_index: create a PeriodIndex from period-like data with a specified frequency
convert_period_to_timestamp: convert a PeriodIndex to a DatetimeIndex with start or end of period
convert_period_frequency: convert a PeriodIndex to a different frequency using asfreq
build_period_index_from_fields: build a PeriodIndex from year, quarter, month, day, hour, minute, or second fields
